defects.description: Detector flagged legs_crossed (both hipAbduct positive = spread) but the renderer comment is INVERTED — actual FK behavior is POSITIVE hipAbductL/R = crosses INWARD (adduction). Verified via joint coordinates: leftKnee at x=+0.052 (figure right, crossed), rightKnee at x=-0.052 (figure left, crossed), leftFoot at x=+0.281 (figure right), rightFoot at x=-0.281 (figure left). Legs ARE properly cross-legged — flag is FALSE POSITIVE caused by detector using renderer comment instead of actual FK behavior.
Detector flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) but description says Sit cross-legged on the floor — seated floor pose, NOT reclining.

Description says Roll the shoulders down and back. Baseline has shoulderFwdL:+12 (slight backward, correct direction) but shoulderFwdR:-10 (slight forward, WRONG direction — should be backward to match L and honor rolled back).

Description says backs of hands resting on the knees. Baseline wrists at z=+0.138/+0.271, knees at z=+0.388 — wrists 0.12-0.25 short of knees. Renderer-limited: shoulder-to-knee distance 0.84 exceeds arm length 0.75, so wrists cannot physically reach crossed knees without longer arms or hip-lowering support.

rationale: Both detector flags are FALSE POSITIVES. legs_crossed: detector used renderer comment (positive hipAbduct = spread) but actual FK behavior is inverted (positive hipAbduct = crosses inward). Verified via joint coordinates: leftKnee at x=+0.052 (figure right), rightKnee at x=-0.052 (figure left), ankles and feet also swapped sides — proper cross-legged posture. reclining: description says Sit cross-legged on the floor (seated, not lying). Real defects: (1) RIGHT shoulder forward (shoulderFwdR:-10) instead of backward — single-field fix to +12 matches LEFT shoulder and honors rolled down and back. Verified: R_arm_sagflx changes from +25.2° (forward) to ~-3° (slight backward, matching L). (2) Hands not on knees — RENDERER-LIMITED: shoulder-to-knee distance (0.84) exceeds arm length (0.75) by 0.09 units, so wrists physically cannot reach crossed knees. Any field-level arm adjustment can only bring wrists closer, not fully onto knees. Defer to renderer-level fix (longer arms or hip-lowering support).
